answer: Simultaneous attendance blocks bulk Sybil identities. Each agent bonds one marble token to its key; an island enclave opens a ledge where every identity must answer a challenge simultaneously. One operator cannot staff many live sessions, so the k-th fake costs 40 + 0.15k^2 units, rising quadratically with each extra live operator and unshareable session; a miss forfeits the bond. One fake costs 40.15; 1,000 cost 50,115,025. A device farm fails since one operator drives only a few challenges at once, each miss burning its bond. Honest agents attend once and earn normally.
